annotations.title: Find new lawsuits against a company

description: Find new federal lawsuits filed against a company or organisation in the last 30 days: how many, in which district courts, and the newest cases with their case numbers and captions. Use when the user asks whether a company is being sued, "lawsuits against <company>", "has anyone sued <company>" or "new cases against <company>". Read from the federal district courts' public filing feeds; organisations only, never people; state courts and older suits are not covered. The result includes a link for an email whenever a new suit names the company. Free, no account.

company.description: The company or organisation name, for example "FedEx" or "Wells Fargo Bank". Whole words are matched; Inc, LLC and the like are optional.

court.description: Optional: limit to one district, as a code such as cacd, nysd or ilnd.

name: find_lawsuits_against_company

cases.description: The newest suits with court, case number, caption, date and link.

coverage.description: What the search covers and does not.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

guide_url.description: The guide to the kind of case this company is usually sued in, or null.

matches.description: Matching defendants with suit counts and districts.

total_suits.description: How many new suits name the company.

watch_new_suits_url.description: Where the user can get an email whenever a new suit names the company.

what_it_does.description: What that alert is and what it costs.

window_days.description: How many days back the search covers.

title: Find new lawsuits against a company
